cd __LOCAL_HOME__/Projects/JavaProjects/docweave
classpath="$(cat /tmp/docweave-validation-classpath.txt)"
for module in docweave-core docweave-pdf docweave-layout-onnx; do classpath="$PWD/$module/target/classes:$classpath"; done
for version in 21 25; do

done
